displayName: Replies or forwards to signed/encrypted messages are signed/encrypted (User)
description:
This policy setting controls whether replies and forwards to signed/encrypted mail should also be signed/encrypted.  

If you enable this policy setting, signing/encryption will be turned on when replying/forwarding a signed or encrypted message, even if the user is not configured for SMIME.

If you disable or do not configure this policy setting, signing/encryption is not enforced.
